output.rationale: The requirement specifies metal-clad switchgear suitable for operation on a solidly grounded system rated 13200 volts line-to-line, 3-phase, 4-wire, 60 hertz. Among the candidates, the product 'CROWN-ARMV' from the CROWN business unit is described as arc-resistant metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear, which matches the voltage class and type of equipment required. This product is offered as engineered-to-order (ETO), aligning with the specification's need for tailored equipment.
